name: CasaVPN
tagline: A home VPN on a Raspberry Pi that looks after itself.
summary: VLESS + Reality behind a default-deny firewall, installed by one script, with an iPhone app.

highlights.label: STEALTH
highlights.title: Looks like a real website
highlights.text: VLESS + Reality: a probe sees a genuine certificate, never a VPN.

highlights.label: CLOSED
highlights.title: Default-deny firewall
highlights.text: nftables, LAN-only key SSH, fail2ban, panel behind nginx.

highlights.label: DYNAMIC IP
highlights.title: Follows your changing IP
highlights.text: casavpn-ddns fixes your DNS record every minute and alerts.

highlights.label: BACKUPS
highlights.title: Backups you have restored
highlights.text: Nightly age-encrypted archive and a restore drill that proves it.

highlights.label: UPGRADES
highlights.title: Upgrades that roll back
highlights.text: 3x-ui pinned by SHA-256; backup first, automatic rollback.

highlights.label: ALERTS
highlights.title: You hear first
highlights.text: Healthcheck, external monitor and push alerts to your phone.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Domain, LAN range, Cloudflare token, age key.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: One script sets up every layer.

steps.title: Add clients
steps.text: Create the Reality inbound in the panel.

steps.title: Forward ports
steps.text: 443 and 8443 only; test on mobile data.
